alex: Heads up — billing alert shows an external project calling our KMS key used to wrap vault backups. I think this is an old onboarding grant that never got revoked. tagging @maya @jordan for triage :eyes:

maya: Which key exactly? can you paste the key name?

alex: key is `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra-keys/cryptoKeys/vault-backup-wrap`
logs show: `methodName=Encrypt resourceName=projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra-keys/cryptoKeys/vault-backup-wrap principal=serviceAccount:partner-sync@partner-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com timestamp=2026-03-20T03:12:04Z`

sec-bot: Automated audit found 1 external principal with recent access to KMS key `vault-backup-wrap` (2026-03-20). See: https://console.cloud.google.com/logs/query?savedQuery=KMS_ACCESS

jordan: OK — immediate mitigation: remove the external SA binding from the key IAM policy and rotate/rewrap backups. We need a two-stage plan: 1) emergency revoke binding, 2) rewrap existing GCS backup objects with a newly-created key version, 3) rotate Vault transit key if backups are decrypted by vault transit. Lia / ops-sre will need to run the rewrap batch.

lia: I can run the removal and start the rewrap job. prefer to run removal now and block access, then schedule rewrap as a background job (throttled). Note: removing binding may break partner sync if they still expect it — need to notify them.

maya: Is this a rewrap or a rekey? difference matters: rewrap = create new key version and re-encrypt envelope keys; rekey = change master key entirely. For our backups (GCS objects with KMS-encrypted envelope), we should do rewrap (safer). Vault transit rotation is separate.

alex: Confirmed backups are GCS with KMS envelope. Vault transit used for runtime secrets (not backup envelope). So plan: revoke binding, create new key version, rewrap backup envelope ciphertexts, then rotate Vault transit if we find any coupling.

jordan: Checklist I want in ticket: 1) remove IAM binding (callout member) 2) create new key version + mark as primary 3) run rewrap job (idempotent) over `gs://redwood-backups/*` 4) validate backup restores decrypt locally 5) update onboarding doc + tighten conditional grants 6) update audit sink to capture partner-projects 7) postmortem + notify CSM/customer success.

lia: I will run these commands during the mitigation window. quick remove command: 
```
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding vault-backup-wrap \
  --location=global --keyring=infra-keys \
  --member='serviceAccount:partner-sync@partner-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com' \
  --role='roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter'
```
Then create new version:
```
gcloud kms keys versions create --location=global --keyring=infra-keys --key=vault-backup-wrap
gcloud kms keys set-primary-version ... (new-version-id)
```
I also have a rewrap job prepared that does a streaming re-encrypt of envelope blobs (will post job id when started).

maya: Don't forget to snapshot current IAM policy and add an audit tag. Also capture the exact log lines for evidence before removing binding.

alex: snapshot saved to ENGSEC-1423 (attached). I'll open the customer/partner notification and ownership ticket.

sec-bot: Evidence snapshot uploaded: gs://redwood-sec-evidence/ENGSEC-1423/8412340000-logs.txt

lia: Removing binding now (will comment with job id once rewrap starts) :thumbsup:

lia: done — IAM binding removed (command exit 0). started rewrap job id `rewrap-20260320-01`. throttling at 50 objs/min.

alex: thanks. pinged partner CSM + assigned ENGSEC-1423 to @jordan for postmortem.

jordan: once rewrap finishes, we'll validate a restore in staging. also update onboarding checklist: require expiry for partner grants + conditional constraints (sourceIp, serviceAccountOwner).

maya: log retention check — make sure audit sink retained >=90 days for this key activity. If not, export to secure bucket.

lia: rewrap job currently at 18% (eta ~3h). will post updates in thread.

alex: good work — after rewrap completes let's run a scoped rotation of Vault transit if we find any coupling. also add runbook note to block external SA at decommissioning. :heavy_check_mark:
